name: EPIC 206002435
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 9.9 solar radii and 0.86 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,614 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.86 solar masses and 9.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,760 K at its surface.
